title: Plunge pool OPEN in 5 Points Hip East Nash!
description:
Refreshing plunge pool in the center of one of the most eclectic & sought after  neighborhoods in Nashville ~ step out your door into the heart of 5 Points East Nashville and walk to some of the cities finest eateries & watering holes!  Country Music and Sports fans welcome, only 1 mile from Nissan Stadium & 1.5 miles to the Country Music Hall of Fame & Broadway Honky Tonks. Come home to a refreshing dip in the pool & relaxation on our 2 decks & spacious backyard before heading back on the town.

The space
If you love to hang outside you'll love our grassy backyard and brand new 2nd deck & plunge pool!  our remodeled 1500 square foot home is casual and has all the basic comforts of home ​​​​​​​in a hip walkable neighborhoods with an eclectic atmosphere.  With 30 restaurants/bars within a 3 block walk from our house and countless more within a half mile, not to mention locally owned boutique shopping, you'll have plenty to explore!!  Front door opens to a large open floor plan living room and kitchen that leads out onto the spacious deck overlooking our large backyard and stairs down to a 2nd large deck and 3' deep 8'X16' plunge pool, perfect for cooling off and sunning on those warm Nashville days.  Pool has locking gates at deck entrances to protect your little ones!  Also a great place to sit and hear the live bands playing from Drifters and relax after a day or evening out on the town! Upstairs Master bedroom has a smart TV and en-suite bathroom complete with jetted tub and separate shower and a second full bedroom and full bathroom with shower/tub combo across the hall. Downstairs is its own private oasis complete with private bedroom (TV), bathroom with shower/tub combo and another living area, kitchenette and washer/dryer.  A tankless water heater ensures enough hot water for everyone in your group!  The downstairs has direct access to the backyard as well as its own entrance if desired.  Backyard has privacy fence with remote opening gate so we can offer gated off street parking as well as parking passes for out front!   Both living rooms are outfitted with comfortable sofa sleepers, TVs (60" upstairs), smart DVD player and Netflix (no cable). Bring your family or friends and come enjoy fantastic 5 Points!

One pool towel per guest will be available, do not take white shower towels outside or use at the pool.

Guest access
Full access to house, deck, front and back yards with the exception of the attached garage and a small owners closet in the living room.
